5213.title: Plugin navigation panels lack a working collapse callback
5213.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin-page host only supplies collapse state for marketplace detail tabs; ordinary page tabs receive the shared layout’s no-op callback.
5213.proposedFix: Always provide the existing panel collapse state and callback for plugin navigation pages.
5213.caveats: Verified on Linux Chromium at trusted main, not by launching the macOS desktop release.
